pages.title: Shoji Doors
pages.text: Tall sliding doors in every wood type, from oak to bamboo. Right-click empty-handed to slide: clicking the edge half (hinge side) slides the panel open into the neighboring space, while the far half pulls a panel back to closed. Panels stack into each other up to 4 thick.

A lone single panel simply shuttles one block sideways, so it needs two blocks of free air beside it; doors lined up side by side share pockets and form wide sliding walls.$(br2)Right-click a door while holding another door item to add panels, up to 4. The edge you click during placement sets the side the door slides toward.
